svg.title: Gate Eel Narrows — Segmented eel contacts
svg.desc: Parallel wet lanes stop at dry gate plinths. Raised contacts, maintenance stairs and a fixed overhead gantry always leave a route outside an electric pulse. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Parallel wet lanes stop at dry gate plinths. Raised contacts, maintenance stairs and a
fixed overhead gantry always leave a route outside an electric pulse.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
Encounter: Tidal Gate Eel · Hostile / Common; optional local encounter.
